name: Water
descr: Water for drinking, cooking and personal hygiene
reference: Sphere Handbook 2018, Water supply standard 2.1, p. 106: minimum 15 litres per person per day, set by context and phase of response (guidance p. 107)

name: Food rations
descr: Ration packs, counted against the food energy people need. Each camp records the kcal of its pack, and until then one pack is assumed to provide 2,100 kcal
reference: Sphere Handbook 2018, Food assistance standard 6.1, p. 198: 2,100 kcal per person per day planning figure. Food energy planning only, not micronutrient adequacy. 2,100 kcal per pack until a camp records its own is a ReliefGrid planning assumption

name: Bathing soap
reference: Sphere Handbook 2018, Hygiene promotion standard 1.2, p. 100: 250 g of bathing soap per person per month (ReliefGrid divides by 30 days)

name: Laundry soap
reference: Sphere Handbook 2018, Hygiene promotion standard 1.2, p. 100: 200 g of laundry soap per person per month (ReliefGrid divides by 30 days)

name: Living space
reference: Sphere Handbook 2018, Shelter and settlement standard 3, p. 254: minimum 3.5 m² of living space per person, excluding cooking, bathing and sanitation space

name: Toilets
reference: Sphere Handbook 2018, Excreta management standard 3.2, p. 116: minimum 1 shared toilet per 20 people in the medium term (1 per 50 in the first phase, guidance p. 118)
firstPhaseReference: Sphere Handbook 2018, Excreta management standard 3.2, guidance note, p. 118: communal toilets at a minimum of 1 per 50 people in the first phases of a rapid-onset crisis, to be improved as soon as possible
countingAssumption: A functional toilet is one that can be used. Sex separation, lighting, distance and accessibility are not recorded

name: Water taps
descr: Water points at a flow of 7.5 L/min
reference: Sphere Handbook 2018, Water supply standard 2.1, p. 106: 250 people per tap, based on a flow rate of 7.5 litres per minute
countingAssumption: Every functional tap is counted at the Sphere assumption of 7.5 litres per minute. Flow is not measured

name: Water containers
reference: Sphere Handbook 2018, Hygiene promotion standard 1.2, p. 100: two water containers per household. Households are counted or estimated with a ReliefGrid planning assumption of household size. 0.4 per person is the equivalent at 5 people per household

name: Mosquito nets
reference: Not a Sphere figure. Sphere Handbook 2018, Shelter and settlement standard 4, p. 259, lists long-lasting insecticide-treated nets where needed, with no ratio. Applicability is decided per camp and there is no default requirement
